contracts: weekly quality arrays are controlled seven-day values; edits write the task draft and are disabled while offline, the task is busy, or that task runtime is running; config saving itself does not disable the weekly select

Trade Station config defaults to currencies 15 and 650053, prevents deselecting the last currency, hides all-exclusive goods unless requested, sorts by quality then item id, and groups purchase history by server day
Dispatch Assist renders selectable allied tasks only when automatic assist is off; active jobs fence selection and manual jobs expose schedule/status/cancel/retry presentation
generic automation cards expose source-specific status precedence plus counters, results, timing and shield rows
AFK searchable targets display recovered attackable ranges and warn when the configured level filter is outside the target range
AFK target source falls back to undiscovered only after target discovery completes
member selection excludes self while preserving saved self/departed leaders and distinguishes loading/failed/offline states
Potion, Alliance Drill, Garrison and Zombie Bus use task/config drafts with source conditional controls and runtime presentation
Garrison enablement requires at least one target and one squad; Zombie Bus details are a status/assignment table
shared task/config store generation semantics preserve newer drafts across older acknowledgements and retain failed edits for retry/discard
reference goods/reward image slots are presentation-only; CORRECT-003 browser fixtures use explicit placeholders rather than invented game artwork

fixturePolicy: All CORRECT-003 preview names, ids, counts, prices and timestamps are deterministic synthetic browser fixtures. They are not game facts and no preview action invokes a native game, purchase, scheduling, map-scan or control service.
